data.body: RP-05 S2a PS4: root-caused CI flake (run A ubuntu/macos FAIL vs run B PASS on same PS3 commit). NOT pre-existing on origin/main — introduced by my own test. test_cli_registry.py::test_construction_imports_no_command_handlers did sys.modules.pop('pydantic_ai', 'rebar_reconciler', ...) WITHOUT restoring, poisoning the shared xdist worker: later test_pai_output/test_llm_failure_classifier hit 'module pydantic_ai has no attribute models', and test_doctor_dirty_tree hit split-module-identity empty-reads/RepairPauseError. Fix: rewrote the import-isolation check to run in a FRESH subprocess (mirrors test_audit_serve_heldout pattern) so it never mutates this interpreter's sys.modules. Also narrowed forbidden set to the honest S2a guarantee (pydantic_ai/rebar_reconciler/_bridge_commands/_commands.* stay OUT); dropped _llm_commands/_workflow_commands which the pre-cutover eager parent __init__ legitimately imports (S6 cutover territory). Verified: victims+registry 79 passed one-interpreter; teeth = injecting 'import pydantic_ai' into _registry drives RED; lint/typecheck clean. Amended, pushed PS4 (stale LLM/Verified votes correctly retired on content change).
